tuto.role: In this game, you play as the manager of a hockey team.
tuto.goal: The game is played in 3 rounds, followed by the Playoffs phase. Your goal is to earn as many <bold><supporterIcon />Fans Points</bold> as possible throughout the season!
tuto.hand: Here is your hand of cards. Each card represents a hockey player you can recruit.
tuto.recruitFirst: Recruit this player by placing them here, on your <bold>bench</bold>.
tuto.attributes:
Each <bold>Player</bold> has 3 attributes:
 • a <bold>Species</bold> (artwork and color)
 • a <bold>Jersey Number</bold> (from 1 to 9)
 • an <bold>Equipment</bold>, under the number. There are 5 different equipment types, and not every player has one.
tuto.teamObjective: Your goal is to create teams of <bold>5 players</bold> that all share one common attribute: the same <bold>Species</bold>, the same <bold>Number</bold>, or the same <bold>Equipment</bold>.
tuto.opponents: Your opponents will recruit a player from their hand at the same time as you.
tuto.draftDefinition: Once everyone has recruited a player, all players pass their remaining cards to the left at the same time. This is called a <bold>draft</bold>.
tuto.recruitSecond: Now recruit a second player of your choice.  Remember, the goal is to create teams with matching <bold>Species</bold>, <bold>Number</bold>, or <bold>Equipment</bold>.
tuto.continueDraft: Continue this process until each of you has recruited <bold>6 players</bold>.
tuto.endDraft: The <bold>draft</bold> phase is over – it’s time to build your team!
tuto.arenaIntro: This is the <bold>Arena card</bold> for the <bold>first round</bold>.  The strongest team will earn <bold>16 points</bold>, second place gets <bold>15 points</bold>, and so on.
tuto.powerExplanation: A team’s Strength (<strengthSymbolMin /> to <strengthSymbolMax/>) is the maximum number of cards that share a common attribute: <bold>Species</bold>, <bold>Number</bold>, or <bold>Equipment</bold>.
tuto.buildTeam: Assemble the strongest team possible. You can check a team's strength by clicking on any of the team member's card to bring up its help dialog.
tuto.busExplanation: Once the team is ready, it takes the bus to go to the arena. Take the bus next to the first arena and place it above your first team.
tuto.busPlacement: Each team’s <bold>Bus token</bold> is placed on the <bold>Bus Station</bold> card, at the location corresponding to the <bold>Team’s Strength</bold>.
tuto.tieBreakers: Teams with equal Strength are ranked using the <bold>Tie-breakers</bold> card.  Teams with the <bold>same Equipment</bold> beat teams with the <bold>same Number</bold>, who beat teams with the <bold>same Species</bold>. <italic>(In 5 or 6 player games, Species beats Number instead)</italic>.
tuto.startRound2:
Each player's bus is now positioned in front of the arena to indicate the Fans points won by that player.
Then, it's the start of the <bold>second round</bold>!
tuto.round2Intro: You keep your first team, and now you’ll recruit new players to form a second team.
tuto.round2Explanation: Each player will have 2 teams, so there are <bold>2 Arena cards</bold> this round. <italic>The <whistle/> symbol on an Arena card indicates an irregular Fans Points count! Hover or click on the arena card to know more.</italic>
tuto.recruitingGoalRound2: Recruit a new player from your hand.  <italic>These new players will mainly be used for your second team, but you will also be able to swap 1 player from your first team at the end of this draft.</italic>
tuto.passDirection2: In this round, players pass their cards to the <bold>right</bold> (in round three, it will be to the left again).
tuto.recruitRound2: Continue drafting until each player has recruited <bold>6 players</bold>.
tuto.endDraft2: The draft phase is over, it’s time to assemble your teams.
tuto.swapPlayer: To begin, you may swap one player from your first team with one from your bench. You can do so by dragging the card from your team to your bench and then dragging a card from your bench to the team. Do it now.
tuto.sendBuses: It’s time to send each team to an arena. Take the bus next to each arena and place it on the team of your choice.
tuto.resolveArenas2: Arenas are resolved one after another, just like in the first round.
tuto.round3Intro: The third round is similar to the second, but now each of you will have 3 teams, so this time there are <bold>3 arenas</bold>.
tuto.arenaSpecialIcon: This arena is special: the <icon /> icon in the bottom left means that <bold>having one of each symbol is stronger than having 5 matching cards</bold>.  If you assemble a team with one of each Equipment symbol, <bold>you’re guaranteed first place</bold>.
tuto.otherIcons: There are other special Arena icons – click on the Arena card to view the specific rule.
tuto.swapEachTeam: You may now swap one card from each team with your bench, starting with team 1. Do it now.
tuto.sendFinalBuses: Send each team to a different Arena.
tuto.resolveArenas3: Arenas are now resolved. The end of the game is near!
tuto.playoffsIntro: Now begins the <bold>Playoffs</bold>: this card shows how many <bold>Fans Points</bold> each player gains based on their ranking. At 3 players, the winner gets 20 points, second gets 16, and last gets 12.
tuto.playoffTickets: With 3 players, each player has one <bold>Play-off Ticket</bold>: it saves you once from elimination.
tuto.playoffExplanation: All your players are back on the bench. It’s time to form your strongest team, because the player with the weakest team may be eliminated!  Choose 5 players to create the most powerful team using the usual criteria.
tuto.playoffElimination: The player with the weakest team loses their Play-off Ticket.
tuto.mandatoryChanges: Now, each player <bold>has to</bold> change between 2 and 4 players in their team. The removed players don’t return to the bench – they are permanently discarded. <italic>To swap a team member, you can drag the new player onto the desired team member, and the cards will be swapped. This can be done anytime a swap can occur in a real game.</italic>
tuto.playoffsLoop: Play-offs continue this way until only one player remains! That player is not necessarily the winner: The player with the most <bold>Fans Points</bold> is declared the champion.
tuto.playoffsEnd:
Now it’s your turn to finish the Play-offs. 
Good luck!
